- The VAT column and line item are marked "np / N/A" (not applicable) and VAT amount is 0.00. Per No Inference rule, do not convert "np / N/A" to a numeric rate. Therefore leave Vat.Rate empty.

- Currency conversions and PLN exchange rates present but are per-invoice exchange rate; rule allows exchange rates only in ExchangeRate.Item (not part of schema). No exchange rate fields required in schema.

- Sender.VatId: "PL 7010600366"
- GrandTotal.Amount: 470.00
- Net.Amount: 470.00
